svg.title: US-017 - Record and correct lesson payments

g.text: US-017 - Record and correct lesson payments
Find owned BillingAccounts containing selected charges
[missing, foreign, or different accounts without grouping enabled]
Validate active and unpaid, create Payment, link charges
Load owned billing account, charges and payments within transaction
Clear payment link and recalculate remaining amount
Save changes and remove payment if no linked charges remain
